album.title: A Century of Setar Music (An Anthology of Contemporary Performance Style)

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on D in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:12.4) introduces A, centred on B. Phrase 5 (0:54.8) introduces E, Gb, centred on D. The line peaks at Gb4 (391.8 Hz) at 0:56.1. It closes on the tonic (D4 → Cs4 → D4 → E4 → D4 → D4).
